definitions.explanation: Along or facing the sea — the strip of land running beside the coast. Often used attributively with の.

examples.japanese: {海沿|うみぞ}いの{道|みち}をドライブした。
examples.english: I drove along the coastal road.

examples.japanese: この{町|まち}は{海沿|うみぞ}いにある。
examples.english: This town is located along the coast.

examples.japanese: {海沿|うみぞ}いのホテルに{泊|と}まって、{窓|まど}から{朝日|あさひ}を{眺|なが}めた。
examples.english: We stayed at a seaside hotel and watched the sunrise from the window.

notes:
Made of {海|うみ} (sea) + {沿|ぞ}い (along). Used attributively with の: {海沿|うみぞ}いの〜.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {海沿|うみぞ}いの{道|みち}: coastal road
- {海沿|うみぞ}いの{町|まち}: seaside town
- {海沿|うみぞ}いを{走|はし}る: to run or drive along the coast

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {川沿|かわぞ}い: along a river — the same 〜{沿|ぞ}い pattern
- {海辺|うみべ}: seaside; beach — the place itself, rather than 'running along' it
